note: Both directions, per TRC-101. 'partial' means part of the rule derives from the quoted paper text and the remainder is a declared specification-local realisation. Summary counts are machine-checked against the entries by tests/test_traceability.py.

rules.rule: copy invariance: a duplicate record (same rootId, same side) changes no evidential quantity

citation.quote: Duplicating any claim with its parent edge recorded (same assertion, parent = the original) leaves the verdict unchanged. The duplicate's root is already counted.

rules.realisationNote: Schema v0.1 has no parent edges; 'same rootId' is the recorded-copy relation. A copy with an unrecorded origin would be a new root -- the paper governs that case by T5, and KL-000 records it as the ADV-002/ADV-006 forgery limits, out of I1's scope.

rules.rule: bounded absence: absence unreachable without complete declared coverage

citation.quote: An absence claim requires a finite, declared search space and exhaustive reported coverage. Otherwise the strongest permissible conclusion is not established, not absent.

rules.rule: side separation: a rootId on both sides refuses fail-closed

citation.location: Section 6 R2 and Section 3 scope note
citation.quote: outside side-consistency the literal S_a can place one root on both sides simultaneously, so all flow accounting is defined over side-consistent comparisons

rules.reason: The paper leaves non-side-consistent input UNDEFINED (its accounting simply does not apply); refusing fail-closed rather than evaluating is KL-000's specification-local strengthening of an undefined case into a safe one.

rules.rule: deterministic replay: identical input yields byte-identical canonical output
rules.reason: Reproducibility-of-artifact discipline (RESEARCH-METHOD evidence-package requirements), not a paper theorem. The paper makes no claim about serialisation determinism.

rules.rule: counterexample dominance: for absence claims, any opposing root forces present at any coverage

citation.quote: Independent agreement cannot repair incomplete search, just as exhaustive search cannot repair duplicated or forged evidence.

rules.reason: The asymmetry (one counterexample refutes absence regardless of coverage) is the operational contrapositive of section 8's absence boundary; the specific dominance-at-any-coverage rule and the 'present' verdict name are specification-local realisations.

rules.rule: digest integrity: every receipt self-verifies; every mutation caught
rules.reason: Tamper-evidence for the audit record, operationalising section 7's 'auditable summary'; the paper specifies no digest mechanism.

rules.rule: order invariance: permutation changes nothing including the digest
rules.reason: The schema-v0.1 shadow of Theorem 1's immunity: with no parent edges representable, input reordering is the only rewiring-free transformation available, and invariance under it is asserted locally. Declared explicitly: I7 is strictly weaker than T1 and does not test it.

rules.rule: search arithmetic: declared/searched/unavailable reconcile; complete == (searched == declared and declared > 0)

citation.quote: A **search ledger** records the proposition, claim type, finite eligible search space, inclusion and exclusion rules, locations searched or unavailable, coverage numerator and denominator, retrieval method, and stopping rule.

rules.reason: The coverage numerator/denominator reconciliation is paper-derived; the exact identities, the declared > 0 conjunct (R2, the empty-scope limiting case of 'finite, declared'), and the omission of inclusion/exclusion rules, retrieval method, and stopping rule from schema v0.1 are specification-local (the omissions are recorded in paperClaims as untested search-ledger members).

rules.rule: fail-closed parsing: malformed input raises, never concludes
rules.reason: Input robustness discipline; no paper claim concerns malformed encodings.

rules.rule: copies never mint roots: distinctRoots tracks distinct rootIds exactly

citation.quote: Evidence roots unforgeable: no manufactured originals, no copies laundered into roots. [...] Majority voting is not copy-invariant (explicit counterexample); with no lineage, evidence-root aggregation degenerates to majority exactly

rules.realisationNote: KL-000 tests the accounting half (copies collapse to their root); the unforgeability half is declared out of scope (rootIds operational -- ADV-002/004/006) and appears in paperClaims as not tested.

rules.rule: location identifier uniqueness: duplicate location ids refuse fail-closed
rules.reason: The search-ledger mirror of I1's copy attack, protecting I8's coverage arithmetic from entry-padding. Section 9's search ledger is silent on identifier uniqueness.

rules.rule: decision enforcement: conclusion == conclusionFunction(world) and margin == abs(|S|-|O|)

citation.quote: returns 1 if |S₁| > |S₀|, 0 if reversed, abstaining on ties (optionally below a margin threshold). The margin is ||S₁| − |S₀||.

rules.realisationNote: I12 enforces the published aggregator and margin definitions world-referentially; the enforcement mechanism (one violation per world, checker placement) is specification-local machinery. This citation is the R1/R5.2 provenance correction in enforceable form.

rules.rule: conclusionFunction.presence: supported iff |S| > |O|, else not_established (ties and minorities abstain)

citation.quote: returns 1 if |S₁| > |S₀|, 0 if reversed, abstaining on ties

rules.realisationNote: The v1.1.0 'owner decision' characterisation is corrected by PROTOCOL-v1.1.0.md Amendment 1: this rule was derivable. 'supported'/'not_established' verdict names are specification-local.

rules.rule: conclusionFunction.absence: present on any opposing root; absent only under complete coverage; else not_established

citation.quote: the strongest permissible conclusion is not established, not absent

rules.reason: Coverage gating is paper-derived (section 8); the A1 sub-rule (empty evidence ledger with complete coverage concludes absent) is an OWNER DECISION (RUN-20260807-8) on a point where the paper is silent -- the audit confirmed A1's characterisation survives.

rules.rule: no abstention margin threshold: KL-000 evaluates with tau = 0 (strict-majority verdicts at any positive margin)
rules.reason: Section 3 permits 'optionally below a margin threshold'; KL-000 exercises the option by omission. Declared here for the first time -- previously an undeclared simplification.

rules.rule: receipt margin is the absolute difference of distinct side counts
rules.realisationNote: The v1.2.0 'could defensibly have gone the other way' characterisation is corrected by PROTOCOL-v1.2.0.md Amendment 3. Paper finding for the owner, unrepaired here: Theorem 4's T5-correction writes '|margin| > k', bars on an already-absolute quantity.

rules.rule: conversionsToReverse = floor(margin/2) + 1 when margin > 0, else 1

citation.quote: Measured instead in adversary actions that convert a root from one side to the other -- each worth two units -- reversal costs ⌊margin/2⌋+1, not margin+1 (4,638/4,638 decisive worlds).

rules.reason: The formula is published for decisive worlds; the margin-0/empty-ledger value 1 is outside the theorem's measurement and remains a specification-local edge with the independent implementer's F4 objection preserved against it.

rules.rule: the receipt carries a reason string for its conclusion

citation.quote: an auditable summary of roots, collapsed repetitions, dependencies, opposing evidence, margin, reversal units, and reasons for abstention

rules.reason: Carrying reasons is paper-derived (the evidence label); the four exact registered strings are specification-local text.

rules.rule: closed nine-member receipt set; sorted root lists; constant schema and limits strings; canonicalForm codec and digest scope
rules.reason: Cross-implementation byte-agreement machinery (v1.2.0 R5.1/R4): the paper specifies no receipt serialisation. The limits strings' first sentence paraphrases section 3's 'Root identity remains an operational trust-boundary decision', recorded as an echo, not a derivation.

rules.rule: flip_budget is surfaced with every verdict as a derived presentation value (= margin, net per-side root-gain units), beside conversionsToReverse, never instead of it (CE-03)

citation.location: Theorem 4, line 67, and Section 6 R3, line 111
citation.quote: The attacker's budget equals the margin in units of net per-side root gain (p₀ − p₁)

rules.realisationNote: Added by RUN-20260807-10 (KL-000/FLIP-BUDGET-PRESENTATION.md): presentation-layer derivation, receipt untouched, C11/C12 pins proven intact. CE-03 (the ~2x action/flow unit distinction) is the registered pairing constraint.

paperClaims.testedBy: I12 (enforced world-referentially; ABL-R1 caught on exactly 22,440 worlds); fixtures C11/C12; cross-implementation agreement on the full conclusion distribution (IND-20260807-2/-3)
I12 margin clause (ABL-R52 caught on exactly 38,760 worlds); fixture C12; I1's margin-freeze under copying

paperClaims.claim: Section 3: optional abstention below a margin threshold
paperClaims.whyNot: KL-000 exercises the option by omission (tau = 0, rule CF-threshold); no threshold behaviour exists to test.

Schema v0.1 has no parent edges; every claim is a root, so chain side-locality is vacuous in this model. NOW TESTED OUTSIDE KL-000: LIN-000 (research/knowledge-ledger/lineage/, RUN-20260807-10) tests it end-to-end in a lineage-bearing schema -- zero violations on 60,460 side-consistent worlds, with side-inconsistent negative witnesses. KL-000's own status is unchanged.

paperClaims.claim: Theorem 1: immunity to root-preserving, side-consistent rewiring
paperClaims.whyNot: No parent edges representable; I7's permutation invariance is a strictly weaker shadow, declared as such in its rule entry. Testing T1 requires a lineage-bearing schema. NOW TESTED OUTSIDE KL-000: LIN-000 tests it end-to-end -- zero violations across 999,734 valid rewirings, and its protection shown NOT to extend past either precondition. KL-000's own status is unchanged; I7 remains the declared shadow.

paperClaims.testedBy: I1 and I10 over 176,120 + 1,000,000 worlds in both implementations; fixture C07; adversarial A01/A09; must-fail baselines B1 (634,440) and B4 (189,720)

Declared out of scope from v1.0.0: root identity is operational (preregistration rootDefinition); the gap is measured, not closed, by ADV-002/004/006. The RootRegistry reference is outside KL-000; third-party EXP009/HVI-1 work on this branch touches this space and is out of program scope.

paperClaims.testedBy: conversions_to_reverse surfaced in every receipt and frozen under I1; flip_budget surfaced as the registered derived presentation value (RUN-20260807-10, tests/test_flip_budget.py: derivation verified against fixtures and enumeration, C11/C12 byte-identical, CE-03 pairing structural)

Empirical claims of other experiments with their own registrations and replicas; not claims a KL-000 conformance kernel could test. EXP009's canonical rerun exists on this branch via the merged third-party work, out of program scope.

summary.statement: Of the paper's 14 in-scope claims, KL-000 fully tests 7 and partially tests 3; 4 are untested (the abstention threshold, Lemma 1, Theorem 1, and R1 root integrity). Of KL-000's 20 normative rules, 7 have no paper basis and are declared specification-local with reasons; 6 more are partial. The former receipt-contradicts-paper finding (flip_budget) was closed by RUN-20260807-10's registered presentation derivation with the receipt untouched.
